Conversation, family & daily routines

mission noun

also assigned task, task

classical

mūnus, mūneris n.

noun, third declension

task, duty or function

Our choice for a playtime “mission.” These are contextual choices for conversation with a child.

Examples

  • Hoc est mūnus tuum: uncum reperī.

    Here’s your mission: find the hook.composed

Other words

  • mandātum, mandātī n. — commission, instruction or something entrusted to someone

    noun, second declension · also used · classical

See also job, quest, search.

SourcesLewis & Short: munus · Lewis & Short: mandatum

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
